Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 18 ноября ст. ст., «Варул Антиохийский, отрок, мч.», with the rank word and «отрок» — which is his age and not his name — left off; the line declines it. source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιο Νήπιο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives «(; - 304)», the year the same day's Romanos carries, and the whole notice is three sentences: when Saint Romanos told the governor Asklepiades that even the children know the idols are not gods, the governor asked an infant which god it believed in; the holy infant answered miraculously, with clear articulation of voice, «τον Χριστόν»; and it was beheaded on the spot. A `death` is proposed from the head line, the page attaching the year to the entry itself. The page gives the child **no name**, so the display name is the designation the line prints and the slug carries the day; `sex` is `unknown` for the same reason — the Greek «Νήπιο» is neuter and the page never says boy or girl. `romanus-the-deacon-of-caesarea` is in `related`, is linked in the life, and is an upgrade on this same day. No `locations` and no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).

death.note: Two sources one year apart and the interval is widened to hold both. saint.gr gave the 304 this folder held flat, which is the year it gives the deacon of the same day; days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 18 ноября ст. ст. with «(303)» and its life page closes the child’s death «(+ 303)». Neither page gives an age or a year of birth.
